_comment: Non-copyrighted summary and preservation manifest for the selected Phase-4 offline contact/hazard cluster. Frame-boundary correlations are not writer or causality claims.
bounded_conclusions: All 13 selected capsules reconstruct without a domain-hash error under the exact pinned reader.
Typed frame-boundary health/lives, actor-pool, contact-pool, VRAM, SPU-RAM and block-flow correlations are retained for the five selected rows.
Actor identities remain numeric fixed-pool IDs; filenames do not establish species or hazard ownership.
Same-frame correlation does not attribute an exact writer, DMA/GPU/SPU producer, attack source, or causal control.

named_unknowns.D08_flies: The capsule bounds numeric actor/contact state only; fly species ownership, AI/attacks/drops/variants remain open.
named_unknowns.D09_cockroaches: The capsule bounds numeric actor/contact state only; taxi/ramming/obstacle roles, immunity and traffic interactions remain open.
named_unknowns.D11_mites_grubs: The two capsules remain distinct numeric leads; mite-versus-grub actor ownership, spawn/AI/damage/death breadth remain open.
named_unknowns.D15_daddy_long_legs: The capsule bounds numeric actor/contact state only; web projectile, range, motion and collision ownership remain open.
named_unknowns.E10_hazards: Hazard kind/producer ownership, exact damage writers, per-stage census, denial controls and lifecycle breadth remain open.
